title: Halted-State Record Run
statement: Let $M$ be a deterministic machine with $k$ Boolean work tapes and state set $Q$, let $T$ be a tag type, and let $S$ be the state type of a two-work-tape seeking machine. Choose a tag update function, the seeking machine, and its start and finish states; take an encoded input word $x$, a four-tape configuration $d$, a record-symbol word $w$, and record data whose state is empty. From the snapshot in the read-exit phase with both buffers equal to $w$, the assembled record-step machine reaches, after $4|w|+6$ steps, the snapshot in the true-verdict phase with empty buffers. Before the final step it reaches neither designated verdict state, and at every step through the run each work-tape head stays within distance $|w|+1$ of its corresponding position in $d$.
